name: 文件中心
description: 文件中心 — 自包含的 office 引擎（创建/编辑/预览 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf），基于内置的 GenOffice 引擎（Apache-2.0），无需外部工具或联网安装

tools.name: office_guide
tools.description: The op vocabulary for this engine (pptx / docx / xlsx). Call before writing office_edit ops; pass group for that group's field tables, examples and common mistakes.

domain.description: Which document family. pptx, docx and xlsx are wired; pdf is not, and answers with a plain "not wired yet".

group.description: Return one op group's full guide instead of the vocabulary. An unknown group lists the valid ones.

style.description: vocabulary (default) = grouped names, cheapest. signatures = one signature line per op.

tools.name: office_read
tools.description: Read a document's structure — pptx slides and elements, xlsx sheets and cells, docx blocks. The ids it returns are what office_edit targets: read first, then edit.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be a document open in this conversation's viewer (any of its tabs — the viewer switches to it).

tools.name: office_edit
tools.description: Apply a batch of ops to a document and save it. The batch is atomic: use dryRun to validate without writing. Op shapes come from office_guide.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be a document open in this conversation's viewer (any of its tabs — the viewer switches to it).

ops.description: The ops to apply, in order. Get the shape of each op from office_guide.

dryRun.description: Validate and report the plan without writing anything.

tools.name: files_search
tools.description: Find Office documents (docx/pptx/xlsx) and PDFs in a workspace by what they are about. Use it when the user refers to a document without giving its path ("the Q3 report", "the proposal that mentions the budget"): it matches file names, folders, extracted titles and a short digest of each document's opening text. Returns absolute paths plus the matched snippet. The index re-checks every file before answering, so edits made outside the app are seen. Plain-text files (md/txt/csv and code) are not indexed — search those with grep.

root.description: Absolute path of the workspace directory to search. Usually the session's working directory.

query.description: A few keywords to match against file names, folder names, document titles and the opening body text — pass keywords, not the user's whole sentence ("华东 预算", not "帮我找那份提过华东预算的文件"). Every word must appear; case-insensitive. Empty returns the most recently modified documents.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: files_probe_write
tools.description: P9a 验收:write a file via the filesystem.write capability (with optional mtime conflict detection).

expectedMtime.description: Optional mtime read earlier — write refuses on conflict

tools.name: files_probe_read
tools.description: P9a 验收:read a file via the filesystem.read capability, returning content + mtime.

tools.name: files_probe_open
tools.description: P9a 验收:programmatically open a panel via panel.open. Defaults to the viewer; pass panelId to open another contributed panel.

path.description: File to show in the viewer (viewer panel only)
